pack.migration: convert the file to the v1 pack schema in src-tauri/src/packs/mod.rs, set version: "1", then run droidsmith-pack-lint

profile.migration: profile v1 is inspected and migrated explicitly to the current schema; review the profile-level Android user target before saving or applying it. v2 loads and runs as-is, and separately offers a reviewed upgrade to v3

quirk.migration: wrap the quirk list as version: "1" plus quirks: [...], then validate it with the bundled quirk loader
